root_cause: The focus trap is not activated when the offcanvas is shown with data-bs-scroll="true" because the show method conditions focus trap activation on !this._config.scroll.
repair_strategy: Activate the focus trap unconditionally when the offcanvas is shown, preserving the existing conditional scrollbar hiding behavior.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus will be trapped inside the offcanvas panel; pressing Tab will cycle among focusable elements within the panel and not move focus to elements outside the panel.
functional_risks: Potential interaction with the scroll=true setting if it was intended to allow page scrolling while the offcanvas is open; however, the focus trap does not affect scrolling behavior.
verification_requirements: After opening the help panel, the first Tab press moves focus to the close button (#help-close).
Subsequent Tab presses keep focus inside the panel (cycling between focusable elements).
Pressing Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the trigger button.
Verify that page background scrolling behavior remains unchanged when data-bs-scroll="true".
